In furtherance to this, Regulation 7(5) of the 2014 Tariff Regulations and Regulation 10(2) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations clearly provides that the tariff petition which is inadequate in any respect shall be returned to the generating company for rectifying the deficiencies. However, the Commission, instead of returning the same for supplying the gross value of the decapitalized items, proceeded to determine the tariff which is in favor of the Petitioner itself. Therefore, the Review Petitioner ought not to be aggrieved by the same. - (e)The methodology of ‘assumed deletion’ cannot fall under the purview of the Review Petition as the Commission has consistently adopted the aforesaid methodology in its orders in various other tariff petitions. Therefore, any methodology that has been consistently adopted by the Commission for the determination of an issue cannot be termed as an error apparent, and hence, the same cannot be challenged in a Review Petition. _Order in Petition No.26/RP/2023 in Petition No. 642/GT/2020 Page_ **_10_** _of_ **_22_** 12.
